relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that oxaliplatin treatment activated the microglia to increase inflammatory responses, leading to the induction of pain.

relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Oxaliplatin treatment (3 h, 1 μg/mL) to the BV-2 cell line induced a significant increase in the expressions of IL-1β (Figure 1B,C), IL-6 (Figure 1B,D), TNF-α (Figure 1B,E), COX-2 (Figure 1B,F)

relationships.subject: syringaresinol
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that syringaresinol inhibited oxaliplatin-induced increase in TNF-α (Figure 1B,E), COX-2 (Figure 1B,F), iNOS (Figure 1B,G), p-ERK (Figure 1B,H), and p-NF-κB expression (Figure 1B,I).

relationships.subject: syringaresinol
relationships.evidence_quote: Syringaresinol treatment successfully ameliorated oxaliplatin-induced cold and mechanical allodynia.

key_findings: Oxaliplatin activates microglia and their supernatant induces allodynia when injected intrathecally
